name: gamemaker-kit
description: Game development workflow plugin for Claude Code. Falsify un-fun in HTML before touching the engine: 29 skills + 4 domain agents covering 4 axes (time / discipline / validation / integration). Playwright bots with 4 procedural personas + your own self-test gate, then a 6-stage HTML→Godot/Unity port re-validation. Domain agents wired into SKILL routing (v0.3). Project-level release-readiness checkpoint via /gmk-dev-complete (v0.3). v0.4-v0.7 completed four half-applied-standard sweeps with a maturing structural pre-flight guard. v0.8 closes the last declared-but-half-applied field with Rule 17 (pillars.kind enum read contract + Check G), promotes Check B (endpoint terminology) from WARN to FAIL after regex tightening to whole-word, hardens both allowlists against silent rot with verified-at-SHA stamps, refactors the shader template under the 300-line soft cap, adds a mock-asset cleanup reminder to gmk-art-gen, and formalizes the HANDOFF backlog template to mitigate F21 anchoring. Third consecutive ACCURATE release. dev-complete is a checkpoint (recomputable), not an endpoint — release and live-ops remain out of scope by design.
